verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen streaming and remote-control app. A product of this kind could plausibly expose a public API, so the axis applies. The evidence documents no public API, no API versioning and no deprecation policy, and probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404. App release versions, nightly builds and update checks are about versioning the app itself, not versioned APIs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
